easyPrerequisites: You have a nonland card in hand.
description:
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Astral Cornucopia.
Activate Tasigur by paying {2}{G/U}{G/U}, causing you to mill two cards and return a nonland card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.name: Astral Cornucopia
uses.cardState: with four or more charge counters on it
